Maddy: Heads-up: StormGate POC warmup failing before exec demo. They're seeing brief 401 flashes followed by 429 bursts at ~20 TPS. Demo in 25m. Can we swarm? @Ravi @Elena

Ravi: Oncall  loading logs. 401s likely token-introspect misses, 429 from per-customer limiter. Send SDK sample and any X-RateLimit headers.

Maddy: Pasted sample in DM. One snippet: HTTP/1.1 401 {"error":"invalid_api_key"} then later X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0 / 429. They deployed an auth-proxy last night.

Elena: Infra: we see introspect 504s for that customer at 2027-03-22T17:12:09Z followed by a cluster of retries that tripped the limiter. Log (sanitized):
2027-03-22T17:12:09Z req=sg-11 ip=52.14.22.9 status=401 err=\"invalid_api_key\"
2027-03-22T17:12:10Z req=sg-12 status=429 err=\"rate_limit_exceeded\" X-RateLimit-Remaining=0

Diego: If their tokens are 12s TTL and introspect intermittently times out, client retries will create bursts.

Priya: Security: common causes are JWKS fetch errors or clock skew. Any JWKS errors?

Elena: Yes intermittent JWKS timeout from their proxy. Filed INF-2308.

Ravi: Fast mitigation options: A) issue a short-lived server demo key (fastest), B) temporarily raise their rate limit for the demo, C) add a small grace window on token validation. Recommend A+B.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: updated customer=stormgate rate_limit=320 by infra at 2027-03-22T17:14:44Z

Maddy: Customer switched to server key for the demo run. Will report in 10m.

Ravi: Metrics: 401s dropped ~95% after server-key switch. 429s reduced after rate bump; brief warm-up spike remains from cache cold misses. Pushed cache-warm tweak to model shard.

Nikhil: I'll update the POC runbook: add \"auth-proxy version check\" and a token refresh test step after any proxy deploy.

Priya: Security approves server-key for demo only. Conditions: rotate key within 12h and log exception in SEC-940.

Maddy: Demo went green. Thanks team. Follow-ups: INF-2308 alerting, runbook PR, pricing note for demo bursts.

Ravi: I'll file the incident timeline and link infra/security tickets. Closing swarm unless objections. :thumbsup:
